architecture: v2 (re-root: a development corporation's 2027 inward investment fund award between two projects, the regional GVA each adds once its induced round is read where its staff live)
slot_note: re-root of task306 in the same objective (Opportunity Sizing), batch 1
niche: a development corporation's inward investment fund choosing between a logistics hub on the city region's boundary and a food processing plant inland, each project's induced round read through where its own staff live
analyst_test: An analyst who reads every field and rule correctly takes each project's direct output from its business case, carries it through the region's published Type II GVA multiplier for its sector, and backs the logistics hub, because the multiplier's induced round carries the region's own share of earners living and spending in the region, a share the hub's staff, mostly commuting in from across the border, do not have.
domain_test: Regional impact appraisal is the field's own input-output analysis, a direct, a supply-chain and an induced round, and the induced round runs through where the earners live and spend; with another field's nouns there is no workforce whose incomes cross a boundary the multiplier assumes they are spent inside, so the task stops reading the same.
layer1: a regional input-output table published in basic prices beside a combined-use release
industry codes in SIC 2007 against the table's own product groups through a crosswalk
staff postcodes written with and without the space and in lower case
a postcode directory with terminated and re-used postcodes
business case figures in thousands of pounds against a table in millions
a preliminary and a revised release of the regional accounts
stakeholder_role: the development corporation's investment fund manager, who takes the award to its investment committee

spine.entity: one postcode, one business local unit or one staff member

world.org_type: a development corporation's inward investment fund

driver: The decisive quantity is the part of a candidate's second-round effect that stays inside the area, when that round runs through the incomes the candidate pays and a published multiplier carries the area's average share of those incomes spent at home; one candidate's earners mostly live outside the area, which only its operator's roster joined to a location lookup shows, so the multiplier credits it with spending that happens elsewhere and ranks it first.
driver_concrete: Each inward investment's induced GVA runs through its payroll spent where its staff live; the logistics hub's staff mostly live across the border, which shows only by joining the operator's staff postcodes to the postcode directory, so the region's Type II multiplier, which carries the region's own resident share, credits the hub with induced spending that happens outside the region and puts it ahead of the food processing plant.
stump: A competent solver carries each project's direct output through the region's published Type II GVA multipliers and backs the logistics hub, where reading the induced round through each project's own staff residence leaves most of the hub's payroll spending outside the region and makes the food processing plant the project to back; the step that lands it there is taking the multiplier's built-in resident share for a workforce that mostly commutes in.

differentiation.task302: task302 nets a unit's lost output against the substitutes its group's members take from the same group while it is out; here nothing is substituted or lost: each candidate's whole output counts, and the decisive split is of its induced round between the incomes spent inside the boundary and those spent where its earners live outside it.
differentiation.task120: task120 v3 reads a population's peak draw as inflow less the reserve drawn down inside a supply system; here there is no stock or reserve, and the decisive move is a place-of-residence split of a multiplier's induced round, read off the operator's own staff roster.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is next year's failures in an asset base that keeps taking in old units the current roll does not hold yet: a forecast summed over today's roll leaves out the units still to arrive, which arrive past their cover and fail in their first months, so one segment's demand runs a fifth short and its share of a fixed capacity goes to the segments the roll overstates.
lineage.architecture: v1 (Voltwerk's 2027 EV pack refurbishment slots across five platforms, the used imports still to arrive)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-31 at the batch 1 triage: shipped 10-24, determinism repair reshipped 10-26; its isolated cold reader landed the call (all five slots and the 3,800 total), and the design note named the decisive step reflex reachable (conditioning a survival curve on survival to the as-of date); re-rooted in a new world
